comment: Zone level bands (owner 2026-11-02; Hibernia fixed 2026-11-03 - Mag Mell is in Lough Derg, the first pass hung the realm on Connla in Shannon Estuary): one starting hub per realm (Mag Mell, Cotswold, Mularn - the modern game's), two paths out at 6-16, one climb to the realm's dragon zone; one hard dead end off a low zone per realm (Llyn Barfog, Raumarik, Cliffs of Moher is the gentler one). The SI islands flow from their landing town. gameutils/LevelBands.cs: a monster's new level is its zone's band, placed by how far it stands from the nearest hub (gradient_weight) and by where its original level ranked in the zone (the rest). Monsters far above their zone (named, bosses) sit a few levels over the band; level 60 and up are left alone; dungeons follow their zone's change at the entrance. Copy to runtime/server/level-bands.json to change it without a rebuild; enabled: false turns it off.
starts_comment: starts: where every new character (and new bot) of the realm starts - StartupLocation overridden at character creation; the race towns stay as towns.
dungeon_exclude_comment: Darkness Falls (its own ladder, for every level), the capitals, Stonehenge Barrows (its levels are its own 30-45 story; Salisbury hardly moved), Avalon City and Krondon (SI end dungeons).

1.name: Cotswold
1.blurb: Albion's first town, in the green hills below Camelot. Gentle country, and the roads lead everywhere.

3.name: Mag Mell
3.blurb: The realm's first town, on the shore of Lough Derg. Gentle country, and the roads lead everywhere.

start_choices_comment: start_choices (owner 2026-11-22): more starting towns a new character may pick on the create screen, after the hub (choice 0); new bots are spread over all of them at random. Each is a level anchor too (the levels grow outward from every starting town). The client shows the same list from content/rules/start_zones.json (a unit test keeps them the same). A wild start is harder (monsters nearer the town, and higher) but pays more (ZoneRates: wild 1.0x against peaceful 0.8x). The hard start (owner 2026-11-24, "one deadly zone being a starting location for the crazies"): one per realm in a Deadly zone - Hibernia's Culraid in Lough Gur - "hard": true, labelled on the create screen, favoured by the tryhard bots, given a trainer and a bind point (HardStarts.cs).

1.name: Humberton
1.blurb: A keep town in the southern Black Mountains, held by the Pendragon's Watch. The monks of Vetusta Abbey wait here for their abbey back.

1.name: West Downs
1.blurb: A downs town north of the Giants' Dance, held by the Pendragon's Watch. Giants walk the plain to the south.

1.name: Caer Ulfwych
1.blurb: A rangers' fort in the middle of the old forest. Merlin sleeps somewhere in the deep wood to the south-east.

1.name: Adribard's Retreat
1.blurb: A dry town on the marsh's north-east edge, across the water from the Isle where Arthur sleeps. The marsh turns deadly toward Cornwall.

1.name: Cornwall Station
1.blurb: HARD START. A garrison station on the Cornish moor, in a Deadly zone of giants and drowned legions far from Camelot. Only the moor round it is gentle.

3.name: Ardee
3.blurb: A quiet market town among the groves and fields of Connacht, kept by the Fianna of Druim Ligen.

3.name: Ardagh
3.blurb: A small, windswept mining town at the top of the Silvermine valley. There's little here: the road runs south through wild country to Howth.

3.name: Brynach
3.blurb: A herders' town on the road from Lough Derg into the Valley of Bri Leith, where Midir's host rides and the wind has turned strange.

3.name: Connla
3.blurb: A busy port at the mouth of the Shannon, with ships, a teleporter and the eriu clans upriver. Wild country beyond the strand.

3.name: Culraid
3.blurb: HARD START. A village in a walking wood on Lough Gur, a Deadly zone far from the capital. Only its edge is gentle.
